output.plan: Find the latest semester by the maximum start_date, join enrollments to their course offerings, and average the grades in that semester. AVG skips NULL grades, so in-progress enrollments are excluded from the average.
output.sql: SELECT AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN course_offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.id WHERE o.semester_id = (SELECT id FROM semesters WHERE start_date = (SELECT MAX(start_date) FROM semesters))
